acceptanceCriteria: A pre-tool Read of src/x.ts in a planning task is allowed by core/workflow-gates and core/writes-within-plan
A pre-tool Write of src/x.ts in a planning task is still blocked
core/no-secret-reads still fires on a Read of .env
diagnosis: Reproduced: in a consumer repo with a planning task, a Read of src/x.ts through the PreToolUse hook is denied by core/workflow-gates and core/writes-within-plan. Root cause: hookScope puts every tool target (Read paths included) into scope.proposedPaths with no tool kind, and markerRealGuard treats any pre-tool scope with targets as a live write (hasToolTargets), so workflowGatesReal and writesWithinPlanReal judge reads as writes. SPEC 4.12.3 L1 blocks a write only. Fix: carry toolAccess read|write on Scope, set it from the tool kind in hookScope, and skip live-write workflow judging for read-only tool calls; no-secret-reads keeps judging reads.
